description: This is a Java source file defining an enumeration 'DepositAccountType' for different deposit account types in a banking application, including methods to retrieve account type info and resource names.

classes.name: DepositAccountType
classes.description: Enumeration of different deposit account types (Invalid, Savings, Fixed, Recurring, Current) with methods for conversions and type checks.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the deposit account type.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the deposit account type.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer to the corresponding DepositAccountType enum value.

methods.name: isSavingsDeposit
methods.description: Checks if the account type is SAVINGS_DEPOSIT.

methods.name: isFixedDeposit
methods.description: Checks if the account type is FIXED_DEPOSIT.

methods.name: isRecurringDeposit
methods.description: Checks if the account type is RECURRING_DEPOSIT.

methods.name: isCurrentDeposit
methods.description: Checks if the account type is CURRENT_DEPOSIT.

methods.name: isInvalid
methods.description: Checks if the account type is INVALID.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the deposit account type, replacing underscores with spaces.

methods.name: resourceName
methods.description: Returns the resource name associated with the deposit account type, based on constants.
